DISPLAYNAME-DISPLAY_NAME.title: Display Name
DISPLAYNAME-DISPLAY_NAME.hover.desc: This will be displayed as your name in multiplayer. Leave blank to use your Steam username as-is.
DISPLAYNAME-SHOW_STEAM_ID_ALONGSIDE.hove:
On the player screen, the Steam username is also displayed in small parentheses below and to the right of the display name.
Even if a user with different settings views their own player screen, your settings will take precedence.
